lines.text: A painting: dogs playing cards. One slips an ace under the table. Did it just wink?
Sit a while, hon. Nobody leaves Rosie's hungry. Or broke. Well. Hungry.
If a crew cleans you out, you'll wake up in that booth. Happens to everybody.
And don't mind the painting. It came with the place.

blackout.text: Rough night, hon? You're at Rosie's. Your wallet's ${lost} lighter.
Your crew's had pie and a little cry. They're ready when you are.

champ.text: The Mossbank bracelet! Pie for the champ. On the house. (Not that House, hon.)

declined.text: Suit yourself, hon. I'm at the diner whenever you want a lesson.

lesson_done.text: Look at you, hon! A natural. Mostly.
Come by for pie, win or lose. Or another lesson.

lesson_skipped.text: Fair enough, hon. I'm at the diner if you want another go.

offer.text: Well, look who wandered in. A dog, on his own, in my diner. Rough night, hon?
I'm Rosie. New to the tables? I'll show you how they work. Pie after.

rest.text: There. Pie all round. Your crew is fed, rested and itching to play.
